title: docker restart
definition: A convenience CLI command that stops a running container and immediately starts it back up again in one fluid motion.
simpleExplanation: Turning it off and back on again.
realWorldExample: You changed a configuration file inside a running Apache container. Apache needs to reboot to read the new file. You type `docker restart apache-web`, and the container reboots instantly.

basic: Is `docker restart` the exact same thing as running `docker stop` followed by `docker start`?

answers.question: Is it the same?
answers.answer: Yes. It is functionally identical, just faster to type.
